title: CinematicCraft
description: A modpack that makes Minecraft a cinematic game while keeping the feeling of vanilla Minecraft
body:
Taken from bearbuildsYT's video "Making Minecraft look like story mode"

It aims to change the animations and look of Minecraft to a higher quality and a cinematic feel like the official trailers

this is my first modpack and none of the mods are made by me they are all collected from different sources, Credit to original devs

Note: This modpack contains Sodium, which might break on some launchers, It also contains Fresh Moves, please refer to the Wiki to animate your character face properly
